title: shop: AI cost
description: Model call cost: the cost reported on the call, else an estimate at the list price the Reliant LLM gateway bills with (LiteLLM's base per-token rates; no tiers). An unpriced call has no cost, never $0. Not an invoice. From the GenAI spans in the environment's traces, so the range is bounded by their retention.
